description:
Title: Blizzard Online Character Generator

Blizzard creates a cool online tool for creating characters for their new WoW expansion.
When creating a World of Warcraft character, you can start doing two things: 
While you are setting up your account, you can already come up with good character names.
The setup of your account starts with checking whether you have a battle.net account.
If you do not have one yet, you enter the account information and click the link you receive in the confirmation mail.
As soon as you have a battle.net account, you can check if you have an active WoW subscription.
If not, you can select the payment method.
If you choose credit card, enter your credit card information.
If you choose your bank account, enter your IBAN and BIC numbers.
After that you can log into the game and select realm, race and class of your character.
Until now, you should have come up with some good names.
You enter them one by one until a name is still available.
You get a confirmation, and some selfies of your character, as soon as a expansion is released you get another message.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_BlizzardCharacterGenerator" targetNamespace="http://example.com/blizzard/character-generator">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CharacterCreation" name="Blizzard Online Character Generator" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CreationStarted" name="Start character creation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Start_Split" name="Start two activities"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ComeUpWithNames" name="Come up with character names"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckBnetAccount" name="Check whether battle.net account exists"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BnetAccount_Split" name="Has battle.net account?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAccountInfo" name="Enter account information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" name="Click link in confirmation mail"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BnetAccount_Merge" name="Battle.net account available"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckSubscription" name="Check whether active WoW subscription exists"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Subscription_Split" name="Has active WoW subscription?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" name="Select payment method"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod_Split" name="Payment method?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCreditCard" name="Enter credit card information"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterIBAN" name="Enter IBAN number"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBIC" name="Enter BIC number"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentMethod_Merge" name="Payment details entered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" name="Subscription active"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Join" name="Account setup and names ready"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIntoGame" name="Log into the game"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Character_Split" name="Select realm, race and class"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRealm" name="Select realm"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectRace" name="Select race"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectClass" name="Select class"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Character_Join" name="Realm, race and class selected"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterCharacterName" name="Enter character name"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NameAvailable" name="Name still available?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Confirmation_Split" name="Receive confirmation and selfies"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveSelfies" name="Receive selfies of character"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Confirmation_Join" name="Confirmation and selfies received"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ExpansionReleased" name="Expansion released message received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ExpansionReleased" messageRef="Message_ExpansionReleased"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CreationComplete" name="Character creation complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Split" sourceRef="StartEvent_CreationStarted" targetRef="Gateway_Start_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_Names" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_To_BnetCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_Start_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckBnetAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Names_To_SetupJoin" sourceRef="Task_ComeUpWithNames" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetCheck_To_Split" sourceRef="Task_CheckBnetAccount" targetRef="Gateway_BnetAccount_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetYes_To_Merge" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetAccount_Split" targetRef="Gateway_BnetAccount_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Has battle.net account</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BnetNo_To_EnterInfo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetAccount_Split" targetRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No battle.net account</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterInfo_To_ConfirmLink" sourceRef="Task_EnterAccountInfo" targetRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmLink_To_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ClickConfirmationLink" targetRef="Gateway_BnetAccount_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_To_SubCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_BnetAccount_Merge" targetRef="Task_CheckSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubCheck_To_SubSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckSubscription" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubNotActive_To_Payment" name="Not active" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">No active WoW subscription</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubActive_To_SubMerge" name="Active" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Active WoW subscription</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_To_PaymentSplit" sourceRef="Task_SelectPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard" name="Credit card" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod_Split" targetRef="Task_EnterCreditCard">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Credit card chosen</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount" name="Bank account" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod_Split" targetRef="Task_EnterIBAN">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Bank account chosen</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IBAN_To_BIC" sourceRef="Task_EnterIBAN" targetRef="Task_EnterBIC"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BIC_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterBIC" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCard_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterCreditCard" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_To_SubMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMethod_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubMerge_To_SetupJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Subscription_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SetupJoin_To_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Join" targetRef="Task_LogIntoGame"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_To_CharSplit" sourceRef="Task_LogIntoGame" targetRef="Gateway_Character_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CharSplit_To_Realm" sourceRef="Gateway_Character_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectRealm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CharSplit_To_Race" sourceRef="Gateway_Character_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectRace"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CharSplit_To_Class" sourceRef="Gateway_Character_Split" targetRef="Task_SelectClass"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Realm_To_CharJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectRealm" targetRef="Gateway_Character_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Race_To_CharJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectRace" targetRef="Gateway_Character_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Class_To_CharJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelectClass" targetRef="Gateway_Character_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CharJoin_To_EnterName" sourceRef="Gateway_Character_Join" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterName_To_Available" sourceRef="Task_EnterCharacterName" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameTaken_Retry" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Name not available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable_To_ConfSplit" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_Confirmation_Split">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Name available</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfSplit_To_Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_Confirmation_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfSplit_To_Selfies" sourceRef="Gateway_Confirmation_Split" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSelfies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_To_ConfJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_Confirmation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selfies_To_ConfJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSelfies" targetRef="Gateway_Confirmation_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfJoin_To_Expansion" sourceRef="Gateway_Confirmation_Join" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleased"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expansion_To_End" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleased" targetRef="EndEvent_CreationComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
